snippet.title: The Referee CONTROVERSY Is Getting OUT OF HAND...
snippet.description:
If you or someone you know experienced serious mental health struggles as a result of social media use, you may be entitled to a potential recovery of over $1,000. Visit https://morganmorganpa.sjv.io/c/7306573/4089046/23429?sharedid=1026-ventures-heat-check to submit a claim now.

The referee controversy is getting out of hand in the NBA… 
Wemby introduced us to the shunk! 
And Dame Time gave us a vintage performance!
Only 4 games last night but we have a lot to talk about so let’s start smoothly. 
Both Lamelo and Jaden showcased their handles in the 1st period, putting OG and Hart in a blender before the buckets. On the other end, the big KAT was doing most of the damage. 
Towns converts the and-1, and look who’s there to pick him up after the fall, his dad - Towns Sr. 
A couple minutes later Josh Hart hit the hardwood hoping for a foul in his favor, but…
Regardless, the Knicks took the steering wheel and turned the game in their direction. 
New York had a 15 point lead at the half, but I gotta show you the moment Rudy Gobert finally realised he’s taller than most of the players…
That was a powerful dunk like a real center should do all the time, take KAT for example!
Brunson and Towns connect for the beautiful alleyoop slam, giving the Knicks a 19 point lead. 
But then, Kuminga took over the spotlight. 
Josh Hart got pushed around multiple times like never before in this one… And JK expanded his takeover to the 3 point line when…
Kuminga erupted in the 3rd, scoring 14 of his 23 points to cut the lead to 12 heading into the final stage. In the absence of Anthony Edwards, he played like the best guy out there.
The Knicks were lucky that Tyler Kolek pulled off this 4 point play at the start of the 4th, because after that they stopped playing basketball, experiencing a generational drought… 
Wow, Jaden buries the heavily contested 3 over Shamet to make it a single digit deficit. 
Meanwhile, the Knicks couldn’t buy a single bucket for 7 minutes straight. They went on to miss 13 shots in a row… 
Yeah, things turned ugly. Especially with the Wolves getting dangerously close in the clutch. 
Lamelo fakes out Josh once again before the triple for the utmost pleasure of the crowd! 
But after back to back turnovers by Kuminga and Rudy, New York was finally ready to put an end to the drought. 
Bridges swished the 3 to shush the crowd for a moment, but little did they know that this was going to be their last point of the night. Still, that doesn’t mean there’s no drama.. 
Rudy got called for the offensive foul, but on the replay we clearly see that there’s no contact whatsoever and the refs overturn the call, giving KAT a tech for flopping. So, down by 8 the Wolves executed the perfect play. 
Gobert throws it down, and on the other end he gets on an island with Brunson who does everything right but fails to hit the shot. The Knicks had only 12 points in the final frame on a lousy 3 of 18 shooting. On the contrary…
Ayo got the fans jumping out of their seats, it’s on now! Brunson wasted precious time off the clock by dribbling the ball up top before he decided to penetrate…
So, with less than 2 minutes to go and the Wolves having a chance to tie the game, the furthest ref of all alters a crucial possession when…
Of course it hit the rim, you got 2 colleagues who are much closer to the play than you. What’s worse is that he stopped the action right when Gobert was making the pass to Ayo who was all alone up top. So instead of a tied game, the Wolves still had ground to cover, and they had 2 golden opportunities just 30 seconds later. 
The Knicks dodge 2 bullets there but continue with the bad offensive execution down the stretch, wasting yet another possession in the clutch…
This is it. 20 seconds on the clock, the ball is in Melo’s hands, New York chooses not to foul…
Let it roll… 
My goodness… The Knicks somehow survived the frantic finish and my agony that lasted for the entire 4th quarter finally came to an end. 
In San Antonio, after Detroit snapped their winning streak, the Spurs were eager to start a new one! 
Mid-range pullups, 3’s, layups you name it, Wemby was doing whatever he wanted against the good old Brook Lopez. But he couldn’t do the same when Isaiah Jackson switched on him. 
Oooh that was a nasty block by Jackson, shutting down the 3 point attempt by Victor. Fortunately for him, the others were cooking in the 3rd period. 
Harrison Barnes turns back the clock with a ferocious slam in transition. The Spurs had only a 4 point advantage heading into the 4th, but they made sure to extend it when winning time came. 
Vassell makes it a 10 point game, setting the stage for this. 
That was exactly that! The Alien comes up with the shunk that only he can deliver! 
And I need to deliver this important message to all of you guys.

Захватывающий боевик с напряжённой атмосферой, опасными противостояниями и неожиданными поворотами событий. Вдали от больших городов, среди бескрайних полей, лесов и заброшенных поселений разворачивается жестокая борьба, в которой человеческая жизнь может зависеть от одного неверного решения. snippet.title: Bina Adrak Elaichi Desi Doodh Se Banayi Mathani Wali Makkhan-Gud Chai Aur Malai Bun! #shorts #recipe
snippet.description:
Bina Adrak Elaichi Desi Doodh Se Banayi Mathani Wali Makkhan-Gud Chai Aur Malai Bun! #shorts #recipe



Kya aapne kabhi bina adrak aur bina elaichi ke taazi tulsi, bhune badam-saunf aur safed makkhan ko mathani se mathkar Jhadgdar Handi Makkhan Chai aur Tava Malai Bun banaye hain? ✨ Jab gaon me desi doodh ko sahi daam nahi mila aur rasoi ke rashan-cylinder ka intezam karne ki chunauti aayi, tab chhoti bahu ne apni samajhdari aur anokhi Mathani Chai trick se sabka dil jeet liya! Dekhiye kaise silbatte ke bhune badam-tulsi masale aur makkhan ke jhaag se banti hai yeh lajawab chai. Aakhir me raat ko Tomy aur makkhan ki matki ka kya hoga? Apni raay comment me Part 2 likhkar zaroor batayein!

🥣 मुख्य सामग्री (Ingredients Used):
• शुद्ध गाढ़ा देसी दूध और ताज़ा सफेद मक्खन (Full Cream Milk & Fresh White Butter)
• देसी गुड़ और कड़क चायपत्ती (Desi Jaggery & Tea Leaves)
• ताज़ी हरी तुलसी की पत्तियां (Fresh Basil Leaves)
• भुने बादाम, हरी सौंफ और काली मिर्च (Roasted Almonds, Fennel & Black Pepper)
• मलाई-बंद के लिए: ताज़े बंद, देसी घी और दूध की मलाई (Buns, Desi Ghee & Fresh Malai)

🌟 Recipe Highlights:
✨ Bina adrak-elaichi ke tulsi aur bhune badam-saunf ka anokha chai masala
✨ Ubalti handi chai me safed makkhan dalkar mathani se jhaag banane ki trick
✨ Desi gud aur gaadhe doodh se bani sehatmand winter special chai
✨ Tave par makkhan aur malai me sike गरमा-गरम Kurkure Malai Bun

snippet.description:

"부정행위 의혹 검증"…어제 오후쯤부터 연락두절
행적 묘연한 이진우…경찰, 주거지 부재 확인

[앵커]
이번에는 취재기자 연결해서 좀 더 자세한 소식 들어보겠습니다. 김태원 기자, 지금 어디에 나가 있습니까?

[기자]
저는 리트 만점자 이진우 씨가 거주해 온 서울 신림동 주택 앞에 나와 있습니다. 


최근까지도 이 씨를 취재하기 위해 많은 취재진이 이곳을 찾아오기도 했습니다. 

하지만 자신에게 제기된 부정행위 의혹 검증을 예고했던 이 씨는 어제 오후쯤부터 현재까지 연락이 끊긴 상태입니다. 오늘 오전 예정됐던 공개검증에도 모습을 드러내지 않은 채 행적이 묘연합니다. 경찰도 오늘 오전 여러 차례 이곳 주택을 찾았다가, 이 씨의 부재를 확인한 뒤 철수했습니다.

[앵커]

snippet.description:
법학적성시험(LEET) 만점자 이진우(32) 씨가 19일 강동구 모텔에서 심정지 상태로 발견됐습니다.
   
연합뉴스 취재에 따르면 이씨는 이날 오후 1시쯤 서울 지하철 8호선 천호역 인근 모텔에서 이 같은 상태로 경찰, 소방 등에 발견됐습니다.
   
경찰은 이날 오전 8시 42분쯤 이씨 신변 안전이 우려된다는 신고를 받고 출동해 그를 추적해왔습니다.
    
이씨는 관악구 신림동의 자택을 이동해 광진구와 송파구를 거쳐 강동구 해당 숙소에서 소재가 포착됐습니다.
   
확인된 그의 마지막 행적은 전날 공개된 한 언론사와 인터뷰입니다.
    
이씨는 취재진에 19일 공개 검증으로 실력을 보여준 뒤 의혹을 털어내겠다고 말했으나 잠적했습니다.
    
이날 오전 예정됐던 검증을 주관한 입시학원 측은 "이진우씨의 휴대전화가 어제부터 꺼져 있는 상태다. 연락받지 않고 있다"고 말했습니다.

*우울감 등 말하기 어려운 고민이 있거나 주변에 이런 어려움을 겪는 가족ㆍ지인이 있을 경우 자살예방 상담전화 ☎109에서 24시간 전문가의 상담을 받을 수 있습니다.
